summary.text: John Fredrickson is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 20 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Fredrickson assumed office in the Nebraska Legislature on January 4, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Health and Human Services, where he is vice chair, and Transportation and Telecommunications.
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary.
